tools.name: subscribe

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "login" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Pair with jobs2.graphai.eu: open /mcp, read the number on the web, pass it here as code. Returns a Bearer token generated on login. Leave Authorization commente…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "login" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "login" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
